Callout.Name: Stolen Bus
Callout.Message: Bus taken from a depot, driver refusing to stop.
Callout.Advisory: Bus heading through the city, no passengers on board.

Script.Line: It came off the depot with no lights and it has not stopped since.
The driver is one of ours and he is not answering the radio.
It cannot get far in a bus. It cannot get far and it cannot hide.

Lines.Approach: He took it empty, so there is nobody on board to worry about. He is still going.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
